question: Who among the following was the first-ever badminton player from India to clinch an Olympic medal?
solution:
The correct answer is __Saina Nehwal__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Saina Nehwal is the first Indian Badminton player to have won an Olympic medal.

 
 
• ​She won the Bronze medal in women's singles at the London Olympics in 2012.
 
• She defeated China's, Wang Xin to clinch the medal.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**P.V. Sindhu:

 
• She is an India Badminton player from Hyderabad, Telangana.
 
• She won a bronze medal in the 2020 Summer Olympics (Tokyo).
 
• She fetched the Silver medal at Rio Olympics, 2016, South Asian Games, 2016 and Commonwealth Games held at Gold Coast Australia, 2018.
 
• She won the Badminton World Federation (BWF) Championships and clinched a Gold.
 
• She has been honoured with Arjuna Award (2013), Padma Shri (2015), Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna (2016) and Padma Bhushan (2020).

**Srikanth Kidambi:**

 
• Srikanth Kidambi is a famous Indian Badminton player hailing from Hyderabad.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Shri (fourth highest civilian award) in the year 2018.
 
• He was also awarded the 'Arjuna Award' in 2015.

**Chirag Shetty:**

 
• Chirag Shetty is an accomplished professional badminton player from India.
 
• At the Asia Team Championships in Hyderabad in 2016, he made his international debut and took home the bronze medal.
 
• At the 2018 Commonwealth Games, he earned the Mixed Team Gold Medal and the Men's Doubles Silver Medal.
 
• At the 2022 Commonwealth Games, he won the men's doubles gold medal.
 
• In 2020, he received the Arjuna Award.
